Owner & Esthetician

Sydney
Gunther

Welcome to SG Esthetics — a Lash, Brow & Beauty salon in Grand Forks, BC, owned and operated by Sydney Gunther. Sydney built this salon with a focus on precision, comfort, and genuine care for every client who walks through the door.

From PMU and brows to lash services and waxing, every treatment is performed with attention to detail in a calm, welcoming space. The team at SG Esthetics is always investing in continued education to bring the best techniques and products to our clients.

At SG Esthetics, you'll also find a curated selection of retail products the staff personally use and believe in — including the Revive7 Natural Revitalizing Lash & Brow Serum and Bush Balm skincare products — all chosen to extend and protect the results of your services.

Book Now

Available In-Salon

Retail
Products

Every product at SG Esthetics is personally selected by Sydney — trusted products to protect and extend your results.

Revive7 Lash & Brow Serum

A natural revitalizing lash and brow serum applied nightly to condition, strengthen, and encourage growth. Gentle enough for sensitive eyes.

Healthy natural lashes & brows mean better service results and longer-lasting lifts and tints.

Bush Balm Oil & Exfoliating Scrub

A premium oil and scrub duo formulated to prep skin before and maintain it after waxing. Removes dead skin cells, soothes the area, and prevents ingrown hairs.

Regular exfoliation and hydration are the most important steps in wax aftercare.

SG Esthetics Gift Cards

Give the gift of a luxury beauty experience. Restrictions apply, please inquire for more information.

Available in any amount — perfect for birthdays, holidays, or just because.

Services &
Pricing

Prices do not include GST

Book Now

01 — PMU

PMU
Services

Prices do not include GST

$350

Microblading

A semi-permanent cosmetic tattooing technique using a manual handheld tool with tiny needles to create realistic, hair-like strokes in the eyebrow area. Deposits pigment into the upper layer of the skin for a fuller, more defined, low-maintenance brow shape.

Follow-up appointment required 4–6 weeks after — $125

$365

Powder Brows

Creates a soft, shaded, filled-in look using a specialized machine to deposit tiny, pixelated dots of pigment. Results in a natural-looking, defined eyebrow shape similar to wearing brow makeup every day.

Follow-up appointment required 4–6 weeks after — $125

$400

Combo Brows

AKA hybrid brows — blends natural hair strokes at the front with powder shading throughout the middle & tail, for a fuller & more defined yet realistic look.

Follow-up appointment required 4–6 weeks after — $125

$200

Refresher

Maintenance sessions to restore the colour, intensity, definition, and shape of cosmetic tattoos that have naturally faded over time. Recommended every 2–3 years for existing clients.

Timing varies based on lifestyle, skin type, PMU type and desired look

02 — Brow

Brow
Services

Prices do not include GST

$20

Brow Tint

Adds colour & depth to brow hairs. Ideal for those looking to enhance their natural brows, especially those with blonde or grey brow hair.

Lasts 3–5 weeks on hairs

$40

Brow Wax & Tint

Brows are tinted to add colour, then waxed using a gentle hypoallergenic hard wax to remove unwanted hairs and create a clean, flattering shape.

$45

Brow Sculpt

Brow shape is mapped out, then a specialized dye is applied that colours both the brow hairs and the skin underneath, creating a fuller, more defined, makeup-like look. Followed by a wax.

Stains skin up to 1 week  ·  Hairs up to 7 weeks

$80

Brow Lamination

Eyebrow hairs are restructured by smoothing & taming them. Allows for more styling flexibility to make them appear fuller and hold their shape better. Includes wax & tint / dye.

Lasts 4–6 weeks

03 — Lash

Lash
Services

Prices do not include GST

$95

Classic Extensions — New Set

A full set of classic lash extensions, applying one synthetic lash to each natural lash for a lengthened, defined look.

$65

Classic Extensions — Fill

A maintenance appointment to fill in any lashes that have shed since your last set. Keeps your extensions looking full and fresh.

$25

Lash Tint

A semi-permanent treatment that tints your natural eyelashes a darker colour. Suitable for those with fair or blonde lashes.

Lasts 4–6 weeks

$110

Lash Lift & Tint

A low-maintenance treatment that perms and darkens your natural eyelashes, making them look longer and more defined without extensions or mascara.

Lasts 4–8 weeks

04 — Wax

Wax
Services

Prices do not include GST

$40

Bikini

Removes hair visible outside a bathing suit or underwear line.

$50

Bikini Plus

AKA "French Bikini". More than a standard bikini wax, but less than a Brazilian. Removes hair from outside the bikini line and further in from the sides.

$65

Brazilian

Removes all hair from the front, back, and between the buttocks — a small strip or triangle can be left. Uses hypoallergenic wax for the most seamless & comfortable experience. Suitable for all skin types.
